extensionDescription.message: iCloud Passwords in Chrome, with Bitwarden-style autofill. Connects to the macOS or iCloud for Windows helper.

cmdFillLogin.message: Show saved logins or verification codes for the focused field

cmdAutofillLogin.message: Autofill the next saved login for this site

menuNone.message: No saved logins for this site

menuScanImage.message: Scan this image for a verification code

noHelperWin.message: Couldn't reach Apple's password helper. Install iCloud for Windows, turn on Passwords, double-click install.cmd in the helper folder, and fully quit the browser.

noHelperMac.message: Couldn't reach Apple's password helper. This needs macOS 14+ with the Passwords app, and the extension must run with Apple's accepted ID.

pinSentWin.message: A verification code was sent by iCloud for Windows. Enter it to grant access.

pinSentMac.message: A verification code was generated on $1. Enter it to grant access.

noSavedPasswords.message: No saved passwords for this site.

codeForLogin.message: Which login is this code for?

noLoginHere.message: No saved login here. You can pick it in Passwords.

passwordsOpenNoteWith.message: Passwords is open. It can't be pointed at one login, so choose $1 there and confirm.

passwordsOpenNote.message: Passwords is open. It can't be pointed at one login, so choose the login there and confirm.

noteOldHelper.message: The PassBridge helper is old. Install it once more from the release page and it will update itself from then on.

couldntFillForm.message: Couldn't find a login form on this page.

totpNotSavedYet.message: Not saved yet: finish in Passwords, then come back

couldntReachGithub.message: Couldn't reach GitHub. Try again later.

inlineMenuHelp.message: When the saved-login menu opens on a login field.

inlineOnClick.message: Show when the icon is clicked

inlineNoLogins.message: No saved logins for this site

blockedHelp.message: One site per line. Subdomains are included.

autofillLoadHelp.message: Fills the login as the page opens when exactly one saved login matches. Can ask for Touch ID or Windows Hello right away.

httpFill.message: Fill and save on HTTP pages

httpHelp.message: HTTP pages are unencrypted and can be spoofed. Keep this off unless you need it.

askSaveHelp.message: Offers to save a login PassBridge doesn't have yet, after you sign in.

askUpdateHelp.message: Offers to update a saved login when you sign in with a new password.

neverSaveHelp.message: One site per line. PassBridge never offers to save on these sites.

copyCodesHelp.message: Also copies a verification code to the clipboard when PassBridge fills it.

clipboardHelp.message: Clears anything PassBridge copies (passwords, usernames, codes) after this time. Windows clipboard history and clipboard apps keep their own copy.

themeHelp.message: Light or dark for the popup, these pages, and the menus PassBridge shows on sites. System follows your computer.

animationsHelp.message: Briefly highlights each field as it is filled.

faviconsHelp.message: Shows site icons in the popup. Icons load from DuckDuckGo.

badge.message: Login count on the toolbar icon

badgeHelp.message: Shows how many saved logins match the current site.

languageHelp.message: Language of the popup, the menus and these pages. System default follows Chrome.

contextMenuHelp.message: Adds PassBridge fill options to the page's right-click menu.

shortcutsHelp.message: Set the keys that show your logins, fill a login, or lock PassBridge.

hidePasskeysHelp.message: Hides the passkey option in a login field's menu. Passkey sign-in buttons still work.

passkeysHelpMac.message: Chrome uses your iCloud Keychain passkeys directly. PassBridge leaves them alone. Hide passkey suggestions also hides these.

passkeysHelpWin.message: Choose Use a phone or tablet in Chrome's passkey dialog and scan the QR code with your iPhone. Bluetooth must be on, and each sign-in needs a new scan.

passkeyStoreHelp.message: Lets PassBridge sign in with passkeys stored in your iCloud Keychain, only on sites where you have imported one. Needs a permission and the iCloud Passwords vault unlocked.

passkeyNoPermission.message: The permission was not granted, so passkeys stay off.

passkeysAllSites.message: Catch new passkeys on every site

passkeysAllSitesHelp.message: While on, Chrome uses PassBridge for every passkey: security keys, Windows Hello and phone sign-in are paused in this browser.

passkeysStayUnlockedHelp.message: Keeps your passkeys unlocked in this Chrome until you quit it. Anyone using this Chrome profile can sign in with them.

syncAllHelp.message: Brings every passkey from your Mac into PassBridge.

syncAllStep2.message: Choose File > Export All Items to App… and pick PassBridge.

syncAllOutside.message: Passkeys made outside Chrome (iPhone, Safari) come over on your next Sync all.

passkeyNudge.message: This site asked for a passkey PassBridge doesn't have.

passkeyImportHelp.message: Choose an unencrypted export file (a Credential Exchange file). Each passkey is saved to your iCloud Passwords vault.

passkeyImportDelete.message: Delete the export file now. It holds your passkeys unprotected.

hideAddressHelp.message: Turns off the browser's own address autofill on forms.

hideBubbleHelp.message: Only PassBridge offers to save logins.

hidePmHelp.message: Locks the browser's offer to save passwords off with a policy, so it can't be turned back on. Passwords the browser already saved still fill. Quit and reopen the browser to apply.

pmSettingsHelp.message: The browser still suggests passwords it saved before. Turn off "Sign in automatically", then move those passwords to iCloud Passwords and delete them in the browser.

agentSignInHelp.message: A local program, such as an AI agent, can ask PassBridge to sign in on the sites below. It sees the site and username, never the password or code.

agentAllowAllHelp.message: Off by default. When on, an agent can sign in on any https site you have a saved login for, not only the list below, banks and email included. A page that tricks the agent could steer it into any of those accounts. A login only fills on the site it was saved for, and each password read still needs your approval. This setting follows your Chrome profile to every computer signed in to it.

allowedHelp.message: One site per line. Subdomains are included. A typed * does nothing here: use Allow every site above.

checkUpdatesHelp.message: Looks for a new PassBridge release on GitHub.

autoInstall.message: Install updates automatically with the helper

autoInstallHelp.message: Installs a new signed release without asking.

checkNowNote.message: Opens the update page in a new tab.

helperNotice.message: Greyed-out settings need the PassBridge helper.

standbyNotice.message: Agent sign-in is answered by another browser or profile right now. Close it there or turn it off there to use this one.

policyRestart.message: Fully quit and reopen the browser to apply this.

reportExpired.message: This report has expired. Open the page again and choose Report this page.

frameUntrusted.message: PassBridge stays silent here (frame not trusted)

reportExample.message: For example: no PassBridge menu on the password field

scrubNote.message: Removed before saving: typed and hidden field values, script code, link query strings, tokens and email addresses. Names or other text shown on the page stay in. The issue and the file you attach are public on GitHub, so look over the file below first.

saveAndOpen.message: Save file and open GitHub issue

savedFile.message: Saved $1. Drag it into the GitHub issue, then submit.

checkingGithub.message: Checking GitHub for a new version…

staleMsg.message: Something went wrong: PassBridge is still $1, not $2.

unsignedMsg.message: This release isn't signed, so PassBridge can't install it for you.

unsupportedMsg.message: This browser can't let PassBridge edit its own folder.

helperMsg.message: Install the PassBridge helper once, then every update installs by itself with no prompts.

helperStep1.message: Extract the zip and open the folder.

withoutHelperNote.message: You pick the PassBridge folder and Chrome asks you to save each file. Click Save every time, or the update is left half done.

readyNative.message: The helper installs it. No prompts, PassBridge restarts by itself.

readyFolderBefore.message: If the folder picker opens, press Select and choose

readyFolderAfter.message: Later updates then take one click.

readyPickBefore.message: You'll choose the PassBridge folder, the one loaded in chrome://extensions, and allow PassBridge to edit it. Choose

interrupted.message: The last update didn't finish. Restore the previous version, then update again.

errNotSource.message: That folder doesn't hold the PassBridge source (no PassBridge manifest.json). Choose the folder loaded in chrome://extensions.

errBusy.message: An update is already running in another PassBridge page.

errNotOwn.message: That folder isn't the one PassBridge runs from. Choose the folder loaded in chrome://extensions.

errVerify.message: The update failed its signature check.

errMismatch.message: The update doesn't belong to this install.

updErrUnsigned.message: This release isn't signed, so it can't be installed here. Download it from the release page.

updErrVerify.message: The update failed its signature check, so it was not installed.

updErrHost.message: The updater helper didn't answer. Run the helper install again.

updErrNokey.message: This build can't verify updates yet.

handedDetail.message: Finish adding the code in Passwords. If it did not take the code, copy the setup key and paste it there.

clipboardWarn.message: The setup key is a secret. Clipboard history may keep it after PassBridge clears it.

pasteDetail.message: Paste it in Passwords, then clear your clipboard history.

noLoginSite.message: No saved login for this site

emptyWho.message: $1. This code can only live on a login.

emptyDetail.message: This code can only live on a login.

pickExplain.message: Passwords asks which login gets this code. You can pick a different one, or create a new login, there.

qrRightClick.message: Right-click the image again, then scan it.

qrNoCode.message: No QR code in that area.

qrNotSetup.message: This QR is not a verification-code setup link.

qrUnlockFirst.message: Unlock PassBridge, then scan the code again.

totpUnsupported.message: This Passwords helper can't set up verification codes.

passwordReadFailed.message: Couldn't read the password for this site.

loginFormNotFound.message: Couldn't find a login form on this page.

passwordReadLoginFailed.message: Couldn't read the password for that login.

noSavedPasswordForLogin.message: No saved password for that login.

refuseFillHttp.message: PassBridge only fills logins on secure (HTTPS) pages.

refuseSaveHttp.message: PassBridge only saves logins on secure (HTTPS) pages.

totpOpenQrFirst.message: Open the page with the QR code first.

totpQrNotLink.message: That QR is not a verification-code setup link.

totpQrNotVisible.message: No QR code visible. Scroll it into view, or paste the setup key.

totpOpenPageFirst.message: Open the page you are setting up first.

totpNotSetupKey.message: That is not a setup key or otpauth link.

totpScanAgain.message: Scan or paste the code again.

totpKeyGoneAdd.message: The setup key is no longer held. Add it again.

totpKeyGoneScan.message: The setup key is no longer held. Scan the code again.

errLoginNotSaved.message: iCloud Passwords did not add this login. Try again, or add it in the Passwords app.

addLoginInPasswordsApp.message: A login with this username already exists here. Finish adding it in the Passwords app.

passkeyUnlockNeeded.message: Unlock PassBridge to sign in with your passkey.
